findings.title: Search request can be overwritten by an older response
findings.explanation: The effect starts a request per `term` and sets state with no cancellation, so a slow earlier response can replace the results of a later query.
findings.suggested_fix: Abort the request in the effect cleanup (AbortController) or ignore stale responses.

findings.title: Array index used as key on cart rows with inputs
findings.explanation: Cart rows hold uncontrolled quantity inputs and can be removed, so index keys make React reuse the wrong row after a removal.
